MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.college = 'Michigan State University'
  AND (
    CASE
      WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
      ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 3) AS INT64)
    END > 1963
    OR (
      CASE
        WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
        ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 3) AS INT64)
      END = 1963
      AND (
        CASE
          WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
          ELSE CASE split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 1)
            WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3
            WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6
            WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9
            WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12
          END
        END > 10
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
            ELSE CASE split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 1)
              WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3
              WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6
              WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9
              WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12
            END
          END = 10
          AND CAST(split_part(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', 1) AS INT64) >= 15
        )
      )
    )
  )
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
